title: At-the-money short-time call-price asymptotics for new classes of exponential Lévy models
summary: We develop at-the-money call-price and implied volatility asymptotic expansions in time to maturity for a class of asset-price models whose log returns follow a Lévy process. Under mild assumptions placing the driving Lévy process in the small-time domain of attraction of an $α$-stable law with $α\in (1,2)$, we give first-order at-the-money call-price and implied volatility asymptotics.
